dag_infos.description: New Taipei City single-year-of-age (0-100+) resident population by district and gender, sourced from MOI Household Registration (RIS) village-level open data, aggregated to district level. Foundational weighting table for apportioning 5-year age bands into the 18-35 youth range.

data_infos.name_cn: 新北市單齡（各歲）人口統計
data_infos.source_type: 內政部戶政司 RIS OpenData API (ODRP014)
data_infos.dataset_description: 內政部戶政司「村里戶數、單一年齡人口」逐月開放資料，提供全國每一村里、每一單一歲數(0歲至100歲以上)、分性別之現住人口數。本 DAG 篩選新北市所轄村里，依行政區代碼前8碼加總為區級單齡人口，並取各年12月(或當年最新可得月份)作為代表快照，逐年輸出，供其他青年統計資料以單齡人口數作為18-35歲組內分攤(apportionment)之權重依據。同時輸出新北市全市加總列(area_code=65000)。
data_infos.etl_description: Call RIS ODRP014 API for a fixed list of ROC yyymm periods (December of each year 2018-2025, plus the latest available month for the current year); filter to New Taipei City villages (site_id startswith 新北市); coerce all people_age_*_m/_f columns to numeric; group by district (district_code[:8]) and sum across villages; melt each single-age column (000-099, 100up) into long rows for gender in {male, female, total}; also compute a city-level (area_code=65000) aggregate; emit rows in the shared youth_fact long-format contract.
